privacyPage.titleTag: Privacy Policy & Disclaimer | Coin Locker Search
privacyPage.description: Who runs Coin Locker Search, how cookies are used for analytics and advertising, where the locker data comes from, and the limits of what this site guarantees.
privacyPage.operatorBody: Coin Locker Search is built and run by {{operator}}, an individual developer.
privacyPage.analyticsBody: This site uses Google Analytics 4 (measurement ID: G-JQ3FRK4J8G) to measure traffic. Google Analytics sets cookies to collect that traffic data. The information collected is anonymous and does not identify individuals. You can opt out by disabling cookies in your browser.
privacyPage.adsBody: This site uses Google AdSense, a third-party advertising service. Advertising providers may use cookies to show ads based on your interests. You can turn off personalised advertising from Google's ad settings page.
privacyPage.collectNoPersonal: Apart from the contact form, this site does not ask you to enter anything, and there are no user accounts.
privacyPage.collectSubmit: Anything sent through the contact form (topic, page URL, message, source URL, and reply email address) is delivered to the operator's mailbox via the form service FormSubmit. It is never published on the site, and a reply address is used only to reply to you.
privacyPage.accuracySource: Locker locations, sizes, and prices are based on information published by the railway operators and locker companies. We do not guarantee that it is accurate or current.
privacyPage.accuracyQuantity: The counts shown are how many lockers are installed, not how many are free. Check availability on site before you rely on it.
privacyPage.accuracyLiability: The operator accepts no liability for any loss arising from use of this site. Service content may change, pause, or end without notice.
privacyPage.sourcesLocker: Locker data: multiecube (JR East Smart Logistics) and information published by individual railway operators
privacyPage.sourcesStation: Some private railway and subway station data: adapted from the National Land Numerical Information (railway data, Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, Japan)
privacyPage.sourcesMap: Maps: OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL licence)
privacyPage.contactBody: For corrections, removal requests, or anything else, please get in touch through the form below.
privacyPage.contactPending: The contact form is being set up. This page will be updated once it is ready.
privacyPage.formTopic_ロッカー情報の誤り: Something in the locker data is wrong
privacyPage.formSourceNote: If you are reporting an error, a link to the railway operator's official page makes it much faster to verify.
privacyPage.formEmailNote: You can send without it. We then cannot reply, but the message is still read.
privacyPage.formError: The message could not be sent. Please wait a moment and try again.

contactReceivedPage.description: Your message to Coin Locker Search has been received. Here is what happens next and how long a reply usually takes.
contactReceivedPage.lead: Thanks for writing in. Your message has reached the operator.
contactReceivedPage.nextSource: If you reported an error in the locker data, it is checked against a primary source — the railway operator's or locker company's own pages — before anything changes. So a report is not applied as-is.
contactReceivedPage.nextBatch: The locker data is refreshed automatically every six hours. Fixes that need manual work are applied together once they have been verified.
contactReceivedPage.nextReply: If you left an email address, you will get a reply once the report has been checked. This site is run by one person, so that can take a few days. Without an address there is no reply, but the message is still read.
contactReceivedPage.nextRemoval: Removal requests are checked against the source the entry is based on. Anything that shows you are the rights holder makes this faster.

guidesPage.heading: Coin locker guides

guidesPage.lead: These guides are written from the locker data on this site. Every figure is computed from the current dataset, which refreshes every six hours, so the numbers here never go stale.

luggagePage.titleTag: Find a coin locker that fits your suitcase | Coin Locker Search
luggagePage.description: Find coin lockers in Japan that fit a carry-on or checked suitcase, judged from the lockers' actual inside dimensions. Covers lockers at {{stations}} stations.
luggagePage.heading: Search by luggage size
luggagePage.lead: Enter your bag's outside dimensions to find stations with a locker it fits in. We judge by the inside dimensions operators publish, not by size names like "L" — one operator's L is 86 cm tall, another's is barely over 50 cm.
luggagePage.resultSummary_one: A {{dims}} cm bag fits in {{units}} lockers at 1 station.
luggagePage.resultSummary_other: A {{dims}} cm bag fits in {{units}} lockers across {{stations}} stations.
luggagePage.resultCheapest: The cheapest size it fits is ¥{{price}} at {{station}}.
luggagePage.resultNone: No locker fits a bag this size — not even the largest one with published inside dimensions. For big luggage, try a staffed baggage counter or a delivery service.
luggagePage.resultInvalid: Enter all three sides as numbers from 1 to 300.
luggagePage.resultUnknown: Another {{units}} lockers don't publish their inside size and are left out.
luggagePage.compareNote: Medium and large checked suitcases come out the same. Both only fit the L-size lockers around 86 cm tall; neither fits the M size below it (50 cm). Going up one bag size roughly halves the number of lockers you can use.
luggagePage.carryonOnlyHeading: Stations that only take a carry-on
luggagePage.carryonOnlyLead_one: At this station a carry-on fits, but no locker takes a checked-size suitcase.
luggagePage.carryonOnlyLead_other: At these {{count}} stations a carry-on fits, but no locker takes a checked-size suitcase.
luggagePage.noSuitcaseLead_one: At this station, none of the lockers with published inside sizes takes even a carry-on suitcase.
luggagePage.noSuitcaseLead_other: At these {{count}} stations, none of the lockers with published inside sizes takes even a carry-on suitcase.
luggagePage.unknownNote: Another {{count}} stations publish no inside sizes at all, so we cannot tell (Tokyo Metro's price-band lockers, for example). Check on site.
luggagePage.prefLead: Of the stations that have lockers, how many have one a suitcase fits in.
luggagePage.rule1: We sort the three sides of the bag and of the locker from shortest to longest. If every side of the bag is no longer than the matching side of the locker, it fits. The bag may stand or lie flat; we don't count fitting it in diagonally.
luggagePage.rule2: Bags are compared by outside size, including wheels and handles. The sizes in the table are typical; the same capacity varies by product.
luggagePage.rule3: Where a locker's inside size is given as a range (e.g. 843–1135 mm tall), we use the smaller figure.
luggagePage.rule4: Lockers that don't publish an inside size are left out.
